notes.title: A Tower, Forever Update
notes.notes:
This update releases next week!


Major ChangesMonth-Long Tower of Titans[p align="start"]The Tower of Titans is a challenge meant to test the power of your Heroes and Champions, but in practice, it predominantly tested your ability to play a whole lot during a single weekend.
[p align="start"]Starting with update 21.0, the Tower of Titans event will now run for 28 days instead of a single weekend! Challenge the tower at your own pace, be it a single day marathon of furious questing or a more relaxed, one floor a day kind of deal. The Titan isn’t going anywhere! Other events will run alongside the Tower according to their usual schedule, so plan accordingly.
[p align="start"]For those among you who eat Terror Titans for breakfast… be prepared. There are whispers of new, tenebrous depths opening up below the Tower in the coming months…
Lost City of Gold[p align="start"]Speaking of other events, the Lost City of Gold is getting a QoL bump, too! The LCOG Keybearer boss will now always be available during the event, alongside the standard quest. There is no longer a need to micromanage quests or waste time flicking aside puny Tier 1 bosses anymore.
[p align="start"]In other words, the Keybearer can now be beaten once per difficulty in any order of your choice. Lock and load those Loot Bugles for the next event!
About the Events & The Release of 21.0[p align="start"]With the great amount of changes that happened in the backend to accommodate this new iteration of the Tower of Titans, please be advised that on the release date (September 2nd) you will need to have claimed the rewards for the August 29th Lost City of Gold BEFORE you update to version 21.0, else risk losing them!
Argon Finally Saved![p align="start"]It took Lilu a bit more time than anticipated, but she finally devised a remedy for Argon’s unfortunate condition! He’s been freed from the stone, seemingly with no side effects. Everyone, welcome back our favorite Paladin!
[p align="start"]A big thanks for you shopkeepers as well for participating in this first installment of our in-game Community Event! We’ve been looking out for your feedback on this first iteration and will be taking that into consideration for future runs.
King Schedule[p align="start"]The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on September 15th to 18th.
Seasonal ContentThe Summer Break Memories Login Calendar[p align="start"]Enjoy the end of summer and the back to school period with us and a specially crafted Login Calendar! Get yourself a poster of Roland enjoying his lifeguard duties on the beach and the fine Fountain Pen blueprint, the perfect armament to get that early homework sorted out.
Notable Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Malady’s rank-up Achievement would not gain progress. 

Any remaining Petrified Coins have been converted to Malady Coins.

Fixed Vending Machine sales not contributing towards networth.

Fixed an inconsistency where some elemental blueprints would show a higher elemental value when inspected on the market.

Fixed a display issue where icons in the HUD (such as packs) would display a white line artifact.

Fixed a minor text issue where the community event contribution popup would use plural terminology when only one point was required.

Fixed an issue where the game could hang when purchasing Guild Boosts rapidly.

Fixed the celebration screen appearing twice when claiming a furniture reward from a Content Pass.

Improved how Resource Bins function on a technical level. This should reduce runtime memory allocations and CPU usage.

notes.title: They Petrified Argon Update
notes.notes:
This update is slated for release next week!
Major ChangesArgon has Been Turned to Stone!
Something (or someone?) turned Argon to stone! Who could it be!? The whole city is getting together to find a cure, and you Shopkeepers are included! Let’s save our favorite Champion by crafting as many Herbs and Potions as possible! Send out the Heroes, too! We may find a cure in some remote corner of the world! 

This petrifying turn of events is also our very first in-game Community Event! Progress is now tracked within the game, as are the potential rewards!

Note that while Argon is turned to stone, you can still bring him into quests. He’s a bit stiff, but still inspiring! If everyone gets together, we can save Argon from his fate as a perpetual lawn ornament! 
Community Events
In the past, Community Events we've had were always handled outside of the game itself. Starting with this update, Community Events are now integrated directly in the game allowing rewards, progress and goals to all be showcased and tracked without having to leave the game.

This first Community Event will start on Friday, August 8th.
Minor Changes
Vending Machine sales will now contribute towards achievements and Content Pass tasks.
Balance Changes
Rebalanced the Titan Admiral Boots and Titan Admiral Arms blueprints to use Essence instead of Ether.

Fixed the Chase Cards first reward step. They will now properly grant a bonus as soon as you collect one!
King Schedule
The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on August 18th until the 21st. 
Notable Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where ascending a Moonstone or Runestone would cause a crash/disconnect.

Fixed an issue where the event reward track did not focus onto your current progress position.

Fixed building tabs in the Building Info menu not being localized.

Fixed the Titan Admiral Arms blueprint missing an Antique Token cost.

Fixed an issue where the Tier 15 filter appeared in Advanced Search for Racks while the player was below the required level.

The Lost City of Gold event reward track will no longer appear the first three times you claim a quest or when no reward is available to claim.

Fixed an issue with Guild Descriptions and Welcome Messages not updating after being changed

Fixed an issue with dynamically loaded images. This should lead to an overall decrease in memory consumption across all devices.

notes.title: Guilds Galore Update
notes.notes:
This update releases next week!


Major ChangesEvent Difficulty Selection
Are events too easy? Or perhaps impossible for your tiny guild? Read below.

With this update, we offer a new power to Guild officers; Event Difficulty Selection. For each of our Guild Events (Lost City of Gold, King’s Caprice and Dragon Invasion), a difficulty level can be chosen.

For players comfortable with event difficulty until now, Hard offers similar rewards and challenges. Easy and Medium are more appropriate for smaller guilds of newer players, offering lesser rewards in exchange for a more reasonable challenge.

Extreme is suited for established guilds of advanced players, wishing to face steeper requirements in exchange for greater rewards. In addition, it features a few extra bonus rewards beyond the Grand Prize, for guilds who want to go the extra mile.

New Event Difficulties are unlocked through the Town Hall building level. Once a new difficulty is unlocked, it can be assigned to one or more events individually by officers. Keep in mind however that an event’s difficulty cannot be changed while the event is running.

As part of this update, your guild’s event difficulties will be automatically set to the highest difficulty allowed by your Town Hall. It will however not automatically be set to Extreme, to prevent presenting an insurmountable challenge to unwary guilds. If you’d like to tackle the Extreme difficulty, it can be manually assigned by any guild officer.

To see the score requirements for the grand prize of each event and difficulty, read further down below.
Minor Changes
A “Personal Best” indication has been added to Lost City of Gold, King’s Caprice and Dragon Invasion events. This way, players can easily see how well they performed in the past and strive to surpass themselves!

Receiving duplicates of Collection Cards now also gives you Card Shards.

Added a new fusion recipe to make Common Collection Card Packs, using Card Shards.

This Fusion is available for everyone!

Updated decorations across the board to be able to attract visitors more easily.

Added new worker statues to Grab Bags.

Artifact blueprints are no longer a possible item requested by Champions.

The Platinum Shop Frame is now available in Platinum Chests.
Balance Changes
Increased the odds of receiving a Chase Card in all the Collection Card Pack.

Chase Cards now give a bonus as soon as you receive one.

Those bonuses have been slightly increased overall as well.

Collection Card Packs can now drop from the Piggy Bank and be purchased from the Fortune Zone Store.

A new 12th quest difficulty has been added to the Lost City of Gold.

Alongside that new quest, all LCOG difficulties have been tuned: quests now last 90 minutes but yield roughly 50% more Pure Gold.

Break chances for the LCOG quests have been slightly reduced.

Increased the maximum item tier that can drop in the Fortune Zone Store from 11 to 14.

Changed the Defense stat to HP for the Titan Scepter Blueprint.
King Schedule
The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on July 21st until the 24th.
Notable Bug Fixes
A long press will now showcase the Blueprint Details in a reward track.

Fixed an issue where Furniture Skins were not purchasable from the King's Caprice Antique Store.

Fixed an issue where the odds of rolling an Ancient Jungle quest component in the Fortune Zone Store and Grab Bags was higher than intended.

Fixed an issue where obtaining a new Collection Card could trigger an unlock notification for some wallpapers and floorings.

Fixed an issue where the Login Calendar HUD icon would show up in the City screen.

Fixed an issue where the Gem Fountain would no longer appear for sale on the webstore if it expired at any point.

Fixed some blueprint types displaying an Airship Power stat when they cannot be donated in Dragon Invasion.
New Event DifficultiesScore RequirementsLost City of Gold
Easy: 3,000

Medium: 13,000

Hard: 110,000

Extreme: 140,000
King's Caprice
Easy: 40,000

Medium: 2,000,000

Hard: 16,000,000

Extreme: 35,000,000
Dragon Invasion
Easy: 50,000

Medium: 300,000

Hard: 3,400,000

Extreme: 7,500,000

Keep in mind that the scores for Extreme difficulties are for the grand prize. A few bonus rewards are available afterwards with higher score requirements.

notes.title: Version 20.0.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Minor Changes
Added the Tattered Binder artifact component as possible loot in quests.

The Collection Score button in the profile card will now open into the Collection Book selection screen instead of the Item Collection.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue with the Collection Score being wrongly inflated by the Card Collection Score. The intended behavior, where only one instance of the card per quality would give collection score, will now be applied.

Fixed inconsistencies with Collection Book statistics.

Fix an issue with the Sondra Collection Card not providing the intended bonus. It will now properly provide a reduction to Fusion Time.

Fixed an issue where the bonuses from Beatrice’s Collection Card weren’t applied properly.

Fixed an issue where up to three of the Worker bonuses from Collection Cards were applied. Now only the primary worker’s bonus will be applied to crafts.

Fixed an issue where Card Collection Score did not contribute to the "Grimar's Rival" achievement.

The “Open Pack” button will no longer display in the Collection Card Pack info menu when you have no packs.

Fixed an issue where Superior Packs were not counted towards the "Mega Pack!" Content Pass task.

For reference, Mega Packs, Superior Packs, Flashback Offers, Anniversary Sale Offers and Black Friday Sale offers should all count towards this task.

Fix an issue with the Collector’s Piece blueprint where its Essence resource cost was abnormally high.

Removed the Mundra's Spite affinity from the Four Wyrms Mace, Dragonwood Bow, Pyroclastic Crown blueprints as this Spirit cannot be crafted.

Fixed an issue where we had missing textures in the early parts of the game.

Fixed an issue where the night time lighting was enabled in places where the night does not usually fall.
[hr][/hr]About the Collection Cards
First of all, thank you for joining us for the high-octane release that was our 6th anniversary! Every year, we are thankful for all of you being here for the ride.

We’ve been listening to your feedback. The Collection Cards feature was always meant as a simple new layer of collection, showcasing art of the characters you know and love. However, it was clear on release that we had dialed the slow-grinding aspect of the feature too far. We have the following actions planned for the immediate and near future to address the most common feedback.
For 20.1 (releasing in early July)
Duplicates of cards you receive now also give Card Shards, in addition to card XP.

Introducing a Fusion Recipe to craft a Common Collection Card Packs, using Card Shards as the primary ingredient.

Collection Card Packs can now drop from the Piggy Bank and be purchased from the Fortune Zone Store.

Add an initial reward step for the Chase Cards.

Increase the drop rates of Chase Cards.

If you’ve already received duplicates of cards, the Card Shards will be retroactively added to your inventory when the 20.1 update drops. If you happen to have already mastered every single collection card, you can still hold on to your packs and Card Shards! There will be more cards added to the collection over time.

We also wanted to address some recurring concerns that have been floating around the community for a while about the future of Shop Titans. While we cannot elaborate much on what we are working on (for now!), we wanted to reassure you that Shop Titans is here to stay. While it’s true we at Kabam Montreal are working on other projects, those are separate teams, doing new things. We have no firm release date for these projects as of yet, but stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Shop Titans Goes TCG Update
notes.notes:
This update is slated for release next week!


New ContentCollection Cards
There’s a new bookmark in the Collection Book! Cards? What’s this!?

Cards can be earned from special Card Packs (opened with gems or earned from events). Each will reward 5 different cards to collect!

There are currently 43 different cards to collect, one per character in the game! Each comes in three different rarities too. When a card is earned, it will automatically be added to the collection book and increase your Collection Score.

That’s not all though, each card has a unique, permanent bonus! For example, the Argon Card will unlock a permanent 5% bonus to his stats simply from earning one card. The bonus can be increased further, up to 25%, by collecting more Argon Cards and earning XP progress towards the next bonus level. Rare and Mythic Argon cards grant much more XP toward these bonuses.

While most cards have 3 upgrade levels, a rare few only have a single, powerful effect. In this case, no bonus is available until enough XP is earned to unlock it. Elder Owen, for example, is one such card. If you manage to unlock his bonus, you’ll gain a permanent +2 furniture space for your shop!

Happy collecting, shopkeepers!


Grand Collection Content Pass
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/cc0b31de537cd19ec7ca6ae696252464a052a8b8.jpg"]

In the spirit of Collection, here comes another Content Pass with some exclusive content! It also includes an artifact, the Binder of Memories! Also exclusive to this event are Mythic Card Packs and Rare Card Packs, special packs that guarantee at least one Mythic or Rare card respectively. Don’t wanna miss those!

Shopkeepers who complete every single task will also unlock the exclusive Antiquarian title.

The Grand Collection Content Pass will run for 2 weeks, starting on June 12th and ending on June 27th.


Anniversary Login Calendar
To celebrate the occasion, we’ve got a 15 days login calendar starting on June 13th! Claim a bunch of rewards every day, including the coveted Champion Titan Soul!


Champion Stories
Polonia’s story has reached its conclusion! What sort of treasure will our favorite pirate discover?


New Artifact
The peculiar Binder of Memories is a scroll whose value increases alongside your card collection! It can be found in the Grand Collection Content Pass.


Minor Changes
Added the Air affinity to Sia’s Fancy Outfit, Sia’s Gloves and Sia’s Sandals. Such elegance should come with some perks, after all.

Added a new "Highest" quality option that enables enhancements such as improved lighting, shadows, and material effects.

Kabam Cross Connect is now utilizing Kabam ID. Overall functionality remains the same.


Seasonal ContentTrifecta Event
As with every anniversary, the Trifecta event (Haggle, Better Deals and Multicraft all at the same time) will return starting on June 10th 11AM EDT and running until June 12th 11AM EDT.


Saint-Jean-Baptiste Day Giveaway
Log in any time from June 23rd until June 26th and claim your free Racoonskin Cap avatar customization from the in-game mailbox.


Canada Day Giveaway
Log in any time from June 30th until July 3rd and claim your free Moose Antlers avatar customization from the in-game mailbox.


4th of July Giveaway
Log in any time from July 4th until July 7th and claim your free Wreath of Freedom wall decoration from the in-game mailbox.


Webstore UpdatesSuper Offer Support
The webstore now supports “Super Offers”, which are the six-panel offers you see during our Anniversary and Black Friday sale events.

This anniversary you’ll be able to make your purchases of the anniversary offers directly on our webstore!


6-Day Anniversary Giveaway
To add to the 6th anniversary celebrations, we’re running a 6-day giveaway exclusively on our webstore. Be sure to check back daily for a new gift to claim for free!


King Schedule
The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on June 23rd until the 26th.


Notable Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue causing the LCOG reward screen to show after every quest clear.

Fixed an issue where the Aura of Inspiration granted 80% increased HP instead of 8%. We’ll settle on 12% in this case. We blame the paint fumes.

Fixed a visual issue where the Chronomancer’s innate skill would appear to have used up an extra attempt when completing Flash Quests.

notes.title: Dragon Boats & Co Update
notes.notes:
This update is slated for release next week!

New Content
Juniper's Jolly June Planting Jubilee!
All of you know of Juniper’s enthusiasm regarding plants. Small or tall, green or colorful, Juniper loves them all. That is why she (and Kabam) is urging you to plant trees around your shop for the good of the whole Kingdom! From June 5th to 11th, add saplings from the special collection to your shop and watch them grow to participate in this special Community Event, Juniper's Jolly June Tree Planting Jubilee! For each milestone reached in-game, Kabam will give out money  (real world money, not gold) to Amazon Research Internacional, up to $20,000 USD for the grand prize! Now we’ve never been to this Amazon place, but Juniper tells us it’s a great spot. 

In addition, we have a special magic-infused sapling that will be part of an exclusive offer running during the event. All the profits from this special offer will go directly to Amazon Research Internacional as well!

Progress for the event will be communicated through daily in-game mails and through daily updates on our website.

Dragonboat Festival Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/6f23b46a956b04dd37febf932f60eabffd3905f8.jpg
The Fantastic Dragonboat Festival Content Pass is coming on May 19th!

This Content Pass has everything: dragons, boats, decorations, blueprints. Show us the longest Wooden Dragon you can place in your shop!

Players who complete the Content Pass can earn the Pro Paddler title!

Major Changes
Pinned Messages
Guildmasters and Officers can now pin a message by pressing and holding on any message in Guild Chat. Only one message can be pinned at a time.

Announcement & Welcome Messages
Guildmasters can now set an Announcement Message and Welcome Message from the Guild Settings menu. Use these new functions to communicate your guild's interests and intents.

Announcement messages will display directly on the Guild Details menu for anyone viewing your guild to see.

Welcome messages will display on the welcome pop-up that appears for newly recruited guild members.

“Welcome Back” Improvements
For players coming back after an extended period of time, the first “Welcome Back!” message they see will contain a summary of major features from the last few updates.

Minor Changes

 Timewarped Components will now be auto-selected (when enabled) when opening the Quest Setup menu as opposed to requiring you to open the Timewarp menu.
 Added Eye Glasses to the customization options, available for gold for everyone.
 Improved the Daily Offer to better take into account a player’s current progression.
 The Guild’s Choice VFX has been toned down a bit, as per popular demand.


Balance Changes

 Removed the Light affinity from the Nook & Cranny Dual Wield Blueprint. It just wasn’t luminous enough to deserve it. We did fix its weaker than intended stats in exchange.
 Fixed an issue where the Ancient Jungle Quests were dropping items of subpar interest.


Webstore Updates
Gem Fountain
The Gem Fountain offer can now be purchased directly from the webstore!
Other Changes

 Offers will now display a countdown timer to their expiration, if applicable.
 The Gem Fountain will also display a countdown timer to the offer’s expiration after purchase, however, a notable limitation is that this timer will not update until you log into the game.


King Schedule
The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on May 26th until the 29th.

Bug Fixes

 Fix a discrepancy in investments per level between The Sun Tower and the other buildings at higher levels.
 Fixed the Painter's Apron customization’s color not changing when Shopkeeper avatar was set to Female body type.
 Fixed the Timewarped Component conversion indicator not showing in the Timewarp menu when playing in Portrait mode.
 Fixed several warnings appearing back-to-back when attempting to sell a locked item of higher quality to a Champion.
 Fixed an issue where no error message would surface when attempting to buy a Market Slot while below the level requirement.
 Fixed the Tier 15 filter missing from Advanced Search accessed from Racks.
 Fixed an issue where Spirits’ skill information was missing from its Item Details menu.

notes.title: It's About Time Update
notes.notes:
This update is slated for release on April 15th.

New Content
Tier 15 is Here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/154d0edb6a8fc1bef5d80479daac707e413931cc.jpg
40 new blueprints are now available! There’s more every year, isn’t there!? 

For this new batch of blueprints, we have to take a step back in time. A pretty big step back in fact, considering we’re time traveling back several million years. Pack a big lunch, because routine trips to the Ancient Jungle quest will be required to craft wonderful new items such as the Behemoth armor set, the Blossomblade or the mythical Dino Nuggies.

New Quest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/bc9d456c90ff1a95a237140bc63cd02a01258c72.jpg
The untamed Ancient Jungle is the realm of dinosaurs! One would be a fool to go wandering these hunting grounds willingly. We really need those components, though.

The Ancient Jungle quest can be unlocked starting at Merchant Level 66, costing 15 billion gold.

Just plain old components won’t be enough for this tier however. Read below on the new Timewarped Components.

Timewarped Components
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/92144eaebeede9de163b558669b49136255ec89a.jpg
It seems that the return trip back to the present may have a beneficial effect on some old components!

Unique to the Ancient Jungle quest, a new option to Timewarp components will be available. Whenever you start a quest, you’ll have the option to bring in a stack of compatible components. If your quest succeeds, these components will be upgraded into a new form, which is needed to craft many Tier 15 items. If the quest fails however, you’ll lose them, so be careful!

Advanced Research
A new special node has been added to Advanced Research. For each item type, if you’ve unlocked a Tier 15 blueprint and unlocked at least one node for that type, a new research node will be made available. Unlocking it will apply all previously unlocked Advanced Research nodes of that item type to Tier 15 as well.

For example, a player who has unlocked all Advanced Research for Swords can have the Craft Speed, Surcharge Energy Reduction and XP Bonus also apply to Tier 15 swords with this upgrade. 

New Worker Levels
The level cap for workers has been increased to 50, provided you have the building level for it. Levels past 45 will have a different effect; the craft time reduction is more pronounced, but only applies to items of Tier 15 or higher.

As part of this change, the experience requirement for the workers levels has been reduced. You’re welcome! 

Login Calendar: A Trip Through Time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/90a14f7e08842a3cc7e252a63028b091c330fdc6.jpg
While veteran players are busy time-traveling and crafting chunky Tier 15 items, we’ve also prepared a special Login Calendar for newer players to enjoy. It contains a plethora of Prehistoric rewards to claim over 15 days!

Though it is aimed towards newer players, there’s no restriction as to who can participate.

The Trip Through Time Login Calendar will start on April 17th and run until May 5th.

Major Changes
New Building Levels
The Emerald Inn and the Tavern now have new levels to accommodate the new dungeon. The buildings of city workers now also have three new levels to support their max level of 50.

Minor Changes

 It is now possible to fully ascend an item by long-tapping the ascension button. You’ll get a warning first.
 The item details menu will now display the multiple item types a Dual Wield item is classified as, the Quiver bonus an item has, and the affinity an item has.


Balance Changes

 The maximum rank of Champions has been increased to 11+60.
 Polonia’s cap on the tier of equipment stolen has been increased by 1.
 Sigils, both True and regular, are rather old news at this point. Their fusion recipe has been simplified to help players get past Tier 11-12. They now require 10 of an appropriate quest component in exchange for 3 Sigils.
 Elysium-related Fusions (e.g. chest and components) now require Supreme Moonstones.
 Most city buildings have had their investment tick requirements lowered. You’ll need more ticks overall to reach the newly added building levels though!
 The amount of crafts required to master mid-tier blueprints has been reduced slightly.
 Slightly rebalanced minimum Hero level required to equip item tiers. Tier 15 can be equipped starting at Hero level 38.
 Rebalanced Merchant level required to unlock tiers on the market. Tier 15 can be traded on the market starting at level 65.
 The Elysium dungeon is now cheaper to unlock.
 

Webstore Updates
Updated Navigation

 The navigation has been visually updated to better display content within that tab at a glance and support a theoretical infinite number of tabs. 
 Some improvements have also been made to scrolling through the navigation on mobile; when scrolling you will now “snap” onto the nearest button.


King Schedule
The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on April 28th until May 1st.

Seasonal Content
Cinco de Mayo Collection
The Cinco de Mayo collection will return starting on May 2nd and running until May 7th.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed Grab Bags awarding incorrect quantities and/or types of rewards.
 Fixed visual issues with background blur on several menus.
 Fixed an issue where chat could be accessed before completing the proper tutorials.
 Fixed the Gem cost for resetting Talent Trees not capping at 500 Gems as intended.
 Fixed the error message when attempting to buy a blueprint from the Collection Book with an inadequate amount of Antique Tokens mentioning the King’s Caprice event not being active.
 Fixed Vending Machine sales not contributing to tasks for selling item tiers and selling items for Gold.
 Fixed the Item Packs section of the store displaying offers meant for early progression players regardless of player’s own progression.
 Fixed the Mercenary hero class not properly calculating effects from Champion party bonuses.
 Fixed a white square that would show up next to the Hero’s status assigned to the Dragon Invasion airship.
 Fixed King’s Caprice Antique Token cost discounts applying to the Collection Book when any major event was running.
 Fixed Royal Merchant Antique Store slot exclusive blueprints being available for purchase in the Collection Book to non-Royal Merchants.

notes.title: Antiques Abound Update
notes.notes:
New Content
Shop Titans Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/ca993228c2d550d8b5c5bcde6c068d85d03ca7c7.jpg
This Content Pass is quite local! In fact, it feels like home! The Shop Titans Content Pass features new yet familiar content based on your favorite characters! Earn Pollux Tokens by completing tasks to work your way towards Bjorn’s Bow, or a model version of Polonia’s ship for your shop! Donovan’s Cloak is also available as a bonus reward!

Real OGs may be interested in the True Shopkeeper title, earned by completing every task of this Content Pass.

The Content Pass will be available starting on March 18th until April 2nd.

Collection Book Improvements
You have long toiled away at the Collection Book, filling its pages with legendary items. But have you ever wondered what the collection book could do for you in return?

Starting in this update, it will now be possible to purchase antique blueprints from within the collection book! Standard conditions apply; the item must be an antique, and in some cases, your account must be old enough to claim the item. One new condition however is that you must master a blueprint of the same line that is one tier above (or higher). For example, mastering a Tier 14 Wand will make all antique Wands of Tier 13 and below available to unlock using Antique Tokens at their standard cost. Until a new tier releases, Tier 14 items remain exclusive to offers and the Antique Store.

As a small bonus, the Antique Store now features a 15% discount on blueprints.

Gem Fountain
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/88dc0109d90d805a9d9a0c892fe7560e18d3d509.jpg
This special fountain is a new offer you don’t want to miss. For the cost of $4.99 (USD), you’ll receive 550 gems instantly alongside the Gem Fountain decoration. The Gem Fountain will then generate 50 gems daily for 30 days! You’ll need to login daily though, otherwise that day’s gems will be lost.

Once the duration runs out, the Gem Fountain will go dormant until the offer is purchased again, granting all of its bonuses (including the initial gems) once more.

Major Changes
Superior Packs
Superior Packs just got a bit superior-er! They now follow a format similar to Mega Packs, offering a bundle of new content in each half, or the complete package at a discount. Superior Packs now also contain two blueprints (with one typically belonging to a Premium line) and a few customizations or decorations.

Talent Tree Refunds
By popular demand, it is now possible to refund Talent points individually. Each point now costs 50 gems to refund. The cost of refunding an entire tree still caps out at 500 gems, so it may be a beneficial option for major changes to your playstyle. Nothing beats a Refund Token, of course.

Minor Changes

 When using the Coincidental Preparations (chance to instantly complete a quest) talent alongside a Compass-type booster, the booster will be refunded if the quest autocompletes.
 Many players learn very late about the existence of the Guild’s Choice mechanic for city buildings. We’ve made it a bit more eye-catching.
 The store button is now displayed on the main HUD.


Balance Changes

 Significantly increased the Merchant XP value of Dual Wield blueprints.
 Blueprints found in the Antique Store now have a 15% discount.
 The Vending Machine Surcharge chance now caps out at 20%.
 The Vending Machine’s unique stats (Surcharge chance and sale frequency) now cap out as early as level 16, so you won’t need to spend many Dragonmarks to get the most of it.
 The Vending Machine’s Max Energy bonus is now double that of a regular rack.

In the longer term, we’ll be looking at more substantial changes to the Vending Machine to improve its usefulness and fun factor.

Webstore Updates
Antique Token Bundles
Just in time for the Collection Book upgrade, you can now purchase Antique Tokens directly from the webstore! Six different bundles are available.

King Schedule
The King will return as a Guest Champion starting on March 31st until April 3rd.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a rare issue preventing some players from asking for help upgrading their furniture.
 Fixed some issues with quests sorting strangely when sorted by component quantity.
 Fixed the Squirrel Spirit model using the wrong Runestone.
 Clarified the Vending Machine’s time per sale upgrade.
 Fixed issues with Grab Bags not awarding appropriate rewards for their color.
 Fixed Moonstone bounties occasionally appearing as non-premium bounties.
 Fixed an issue where using the “None” filter would prevent the Apply button from working properly in Advanced Search.


Fixed Market information (quantity, sale price, etc.) for items in inventory not populating when below the level requirements for that item tier.

notes.title: Version 18.3.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:

notes.title: The Veteran Update
notes.notes:
New Content
New Worker - The Veteran!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/4cffb2e02373305375e99c1281af73b2fe62faea.jpg
Attention, soldiers! Roland Knecht has arrived!

Hailing from many battlefields, the Veteran is now ready to settle in more peaceful pastures. He brings with him a wealth of military knowledge, including the ability to craft Dual Wield Weapons and Quivers!

But that’s not all. As a renowned drill instructor, he knows how to whip those Heroes into shape! His Premium Worker ability allows you to, once per Hero, replace a skill with any skill of your choice. The only restrictions are that it must be a skill that Hero can learn normally, and one that is not already known to the Hero. It can be any skill slot and any skill rarity.

All Heroes, new and old, can benefit from this effect once each.

Roland is available for purchase for players at level 32 or higher.

New Blueprint Type - Quivers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/d16f2dd2009dd601b51f3870de3030e34c6887ce.jpg
In a world where ammo is infinite, can there be a market for quivers? If there is a will, there is a way. These quivers are quite the bundle and contain arrows, bolts and bullets at the same time!

Due to this, it also has a few special rules. One, it can only be equipped alongside a Gun, Crossbow or Bow. It’s not too useful otherwise! If it’s equipped alongside another weapon, it will be disabled and provide no stat bonuses.

Two, it bears a special affinity for Bows, which gain a 30% item bonus when equipped alongside a quiver. One cannot name a more iconic duo, after all.

Rest assured however that Guns, Crossbows and Bows can still function without the help of a quiver if one prefers.

New Blueprint Type - Dual Wield!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/3653c5c2e39b1bac74167e502c0c123bed42c726.jpg
Perhaps our most unique item type yet!

From a crafting point of view, Dual wield is conventional. It is its own blueprint line, with its own Ascension Milestones and Advanced Research. Let’s take the Crystal Destroyers blueprint, for example. It is a Dual Wield blueprint featuring an Axe and a Mace. The result is a single item (Crystal Destroyers) that can be sold and equipped normally, benefitting from Dual Wield crafting upgrades, but not from Axe or Mace ones.

When it comes to Heroes though, things get more unique. No Hero class can explicitly equip Dual Wield items. So long as they can normally wield one of the weapons part of the Dual Wield, they can wield it! A Cleric for example could equip the Crystal Destroyers, even if they can’t normally use Axes.

This logic is similar for Hero skills. While no skill specifically enhances Dual Wield, other skills such as Mace Master would grant their full bonus to the Crystal Destroyers. Similarly, a Thief (with its innate bonus to Daggers) with the Sword Master skill would receive the benefit of both skills if equipped with a Sword/Dagger Dual Wield item. Do keep in mind however that a single skill (e.g Warlord) will never grant its bonus twice.

notes.notes:
New Content

It is now possible to assign a Favored Quest to a party preset. Whenever a Favored Quest is selected, the default party will be chosen among those with that quest as favorite, provided the team is rested and ready to go.

Mega Dungeon Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/22e50731c785432196c548eabdc85838e64e95f0.png
Troublins tremble! The Mega Dungeon Content Pass has come! It features blueprints themed around our many dungeons, with the Troublin Bento as the Grand Prize. Complete tasks to collect Emblems and unlock all this content!

Super Dungeoneers can work towards the Dungeon Master title, unlocked only by completing every single task of the event.

The Mega Dungeon Content Pass will run for two weeks, starting on September 10th and ending on September 25th.

Major Changes
Break System Refactor
Previously, the Break system was a needlessly complex matter. To put it simply, items would roll to break every round, making it very punishing for low damage parties, even if they could otherwise reliably tank their way to victory. It made for a very uneven experience across players which could be very frustrating, particularly during the Lost City of Gold event.

As of now, each quest instead has a specific amount of Break attempts it will do among items owned by quest survivors. Items can resist these break attempts with their Break Chance, with item quality, the Engineer and similar bonuses applying as normal.

As an added bonus, very early quests no longer break items (or have very low break chance) to ease in new players and allow them to stockpile repair kits.

Optimization
Memory usage footprint from textures reduced by approximately 30% and app size by around 10%.

Minor Changes

 When visiting a guildmate’s shop and their game version differs from yours, the message now more accurately explains what’s going on.
 Aurasongs can now break. Familiars were (and remain) unbreakable to avoid gruesome implications, but this immunity was extended to Aurasongs by default due to them also being Champion items.

Balance Changes

Bounties have been in a weird place for a long time, best described as “tiresome”. They ask for highly specific crafts that rarely overlap with the current goals of the player, forcing them to choose between progress and bounty completion.

Piggy Bank Refactor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/1317831cc6d5c1e4f9bc0d8fe045711a1638fe33.png
The Piggy Banks have received substantial changes! The Golden Pig in particular now prominently features various antiques, with very high chances of generating a decoration, customization, wallpaper or flooring. There’s also a small chance to roll a blueprint!*

In addition, new players will start the weekly pig cycle with a Golden Pig immediately. After opening it, they’ll need to open one regular pig before their next Golden Pig. The next cycle will require 2 regular pigs, and so on until they reach the usual and final cycle of 6 regular pigs per Golden Pig. Though it is meant as an introductory progression for new players, current players will also get to benefit from it.

Other changes:

 The Golden Pig now drops bigger stacks of Ascension Shards and Research Scrolls (25 instead of 10).
 The Golden Pig is more likely to drop better Keys (specifically, Volcano and up).
 The Golden Pig now drops bigger stacks of Champion Coins (30 instead of 5).
 As the Golden Pig no longer features Gems, the regular pigs drop higher quantities (25 instead of 15).
 Regular pigs no longer drop quest components. Runestones and Moonstones are still available.
 The gold amount required to open a daily piggy bank has always scaled with the value of blueprints owned by the payer. Starting now, blueprints that have never been crafted will not be taken into account.


*As a special rule, on top of the usual Antique rules, blueprints must be at least one year old to become valid Golden Pig prizes. They also cannot be of a tier higher than you’ve ever crafted.

Maces VS Spears Community Challenge
This is a crafting challenge for all of you! Maces and Spears clash!

Every shopkeeper must work together to craft 25 million tiers worth of Maces and Spears! You’ll have one week, but if everyone pitches in, we know you can do it!

If the community manages to reach this goal, we’ll be giving out one free blueprint to everyone. But! There’s also a choice to be made here!

The two available blueprints are the Tower of Thorns Mace and the Blackthorn Razor Spear. Whichever item type generated the most tiers will be crowned the winner, and its blueprint will be given out. The other will fade into oblivion forever*.

The event starts on August 16th and ends on the 23rd. Blueprints crafted before this date will not count. A mail will be sent announcing the start of the event, and progress will be reported through daily mails, as well as daily updates on our website.

*It will probably come back as part of an offer or something.

Basic Decorations
We’ve added a few new decorations, wallpapers and floorings, available for little gold and at early levels. Except for the golden toilet skin. That one costs 1 billion gold.

Customization Colors
New colors have been added to the list. Some existing colors have been slightly modified.

Major Changes
Guild Creation
There’s a lot of guilds out there. Too many, some would argue. Joining a good guild is a vital part of a player’s Shop Titans journey, but due to the sheer quantity of them, the player base tends to get fragmented into a bunch of half-full guilds, constantly battling to acquire more members.

Starting with this update, it will no longer be possible to create a guild with gold. This option is exclusive to gems and now costs 500 (up from 200). We’ll be closely monitoring the results over the following weeks and may loosen (or tighten) these restrictions.

Minor Changes

 Attempting to clean up a player’s shop whose version is mismatched will now automatically clear the notification and also grant you the reward. The text message will be updated shortly to better reflect this.
 Newly acquired decorations, wallpapers and floorings are now sorted first in the list until seen by the player. No longer need to dig in there!
 Improved the visuals of the Tier 14 enchantment icons to better match the previous tiers.
 Extra Trophies granted by the Cooking the Books talent now look a little bit different.
 When equipping Vanity Gear, it is now possible to choose the displayed color of Kaleidoscopic items. Finally.
 The loading screen now features basic gameplay tips.
 Guilds can now set a minimum investment requirement in addition to the minimum level requirement.
 There is now a visual cue when the Crafter’s Trick and Zero Waste talents trigger.
 Content Passes are now available starting at level 20, up from level 8.
 Adjusted the difficulty of many Lilu Blitz Pass tasks as they were rather difficult.
 Added a filter for Artifacts to the inventory’s Advanced Search.
 Enchantments on items can once again be modified from the Market or Dragon Invasion menu.


Webstore Updates
Personalized Offers Support
The next phase of the webstore is almost here. Starting after the release of 17.2 — on or around August 19th — the webstore will begin supporting a selection of personalized offers. You will now be able to purchase the latest Mega and Superior Packs directly from the webstore!

During this initial rollout, the following offers will be supported:

 Mega Packs
 Superior Packs
 Flashback Offers


As we look towards the future and as previously hinted, we will continue to work towards supporting more personalized offers, such as Naya offers.

King Schedule
King Reinhold will be available as a Guest Champion on August 19th, leaving on the 22nd.

Bug Fixes

 Further fixes to artifact components on the Market.
 Fixed a bug where the Yule’s Herald and Platinum Scepter staves shared the same power level as the Scepter of Ever-Wisdom. This reduces their stats and also removes the secondary stat from the Platinum Scepter.
 Fixed an issue where, while attempting to reroll a skill, other mutually exclusive skills would not display as part of the possible skill list, even though they would be valid results from this reroll.
 Fixed the Titan Spirit missing audio.
 Fixed Lone Wolf Hood wearers receiving bonuses from Champion Skills on the Airship during Dragon Invasion.
 Fixed a display issue that would occur when a customer already carrying an instrument would buy another instrument. Purchasing a new instrument will now overwrite the previous one.
 Fixed a minor display issue causing icons to appear grayed out on the “Missing requirements” popup.
 Fixed an issue where shop space could not be switched into a yard.


These release notes previously — erroneously — listed the following as changed in this release; it is instead slated for a future release:

 Updated the visuals of the surcharge energy cost value to make it easier to read.

This update is slated for release next week!

Pirate Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/a7f59938178487215e4383f24e36038a0ee87779.png
Are you ready, kids? I can’t hear you!

From the briny depths comes a new content pass, full of new content! For the grand prize, look forward to the barnacled Kraken Shank dagger, as well as plenty more seafaring items!

Accomplished buccaneers can also look forward to the Pirate King/Queen title, only available to those who finish every task!

This Content Pass will run for four weeks, starting on July 9th and ending on August 6th.

Polonia’s Jolly Roger
The Content Pass contains a special decoration! This pirate flag has the special ability to track Polonia’s thieving prowess and remembers how many items she’s stolen during her lifetime. Simply inspect the decoration to learn her current score.

Tracking will also happen even while the decoration is stored away. Keep in mind however that thefts prior to this update were not tracked.

Seed of Merit Fusion
It’s finally available! You can fuse your own Seeds of Merit with the following recipe:


 10x Seeds of Vitality

Blitz Pass

notes.title: Five Years of Shop Titans Update
notes.notes:
This update is slated for release next week!

Has it already been five years already? Time sure flies! For such a momentous occasion, we’ve cooked up a big update!

New Content
Artifact Blueprints
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/b3c8b5e4d811b8bac201f81d7202c9151efd7638.jpg
Artifact blueprints are a new and special type of blueprint! They have a couple of unique rules.


 They are only found in the Greater Artifact (T14) and Minor Artifact (T8-9) chests.
 Each artifact has its own unique component that is required to craft it.
 Artifacts are, at a base, stronger and more valuable than blueprints of the same tier.
 Each artifact has a special, unique effect that is not found anywhere else.
 A Hero cannot equip more than one artifact at the same time.


They’re more difficult to craft and acquire compared to your average blueprint, but also more rewarding. Here’s a sneak peek at the six Artifact blueprints currently available in the game.

Kiku-Ichimonji (Greater Artifact)
This Katana is unnaturally sharp, but unwieldy! It provides a powerful +200% bonus to Critical Damage, but sets your critical hit rate to 20%. If your actual critical chance was lower, great! If it was higher, it would be lowered to 20%.

The Samurai’s guaranteed critical hit on the first round completely ignores Critical Hit Chance, so they are not as hindered by this effect.

Torc of Peace (Greater Artifact)
This powerful amulet magically seals the power of any wielded weapon, rendering them completely useless. In exchange, it grants a sizable +10% evasion and a 20% skill HP bonus.

There’s a loophole though; fists and shields aren’t considered weapons!

Armor of Invincibility (Greater Artifact)
This suit of heavy armor completely shrugs off any amount of damage it takes, no matter how powerful. As a result, it will never break!

The lucky wearer, however, is not actually invincible.

Lone Wolf Cowl (Minor Artifact)
For loners who are too cool for teamwork, there is the Lone Wolf Cowl. The wearer completely ignores bonuses granted by Champions in exchange for a powerful 40% skill bonus to ATK and DEF. Perfect if your Champions are taking a nap, or if they’re simply not that strong in the first place.

It is worth noting that effects that do not directly apply to Heroes, such as Sia’s looting or Yami’s quest speed, will function as usual.

Grimar’s Collection (Minor Artifact)
This spellbook provides no outstanding combat bonuses, but it’s worth a LOT of Collection Score! Grimar’s collection book contains ancient items that simply don’t exist in this day and age.

Pickaxe of Greed (Minor Artifact)
Dig too deep and too greedily with this needlessly gaudy pickaxe! It is particularly adept at defeating guardians of golden treasures. Any Hero wielding it will deal double damage to Golems!

Upcoming Artifacts
Two extra Greater Artifacts will also be released in the coming days. Stay tuned!

Artifact Chests
Artifact chests are a bit special. Since they aren’t associated with a particular quest, they don’t drop from anywhere. Whenever you find your first Artifact chest key, the associated chest will become available at an infinite quantity.

Artifact Keys may be rewarded through events occasionally. Other than that, a Minor Artifact Key is automatically awarded upon reaching level 45, and a Greater Artifact Key upon reaching level 65.

Artifact Components
Artifact components behave the same as regular components in most ways. Where they differ is their acquisition; they are quite rare! They can be found as a rare random drop in regular quests. In addition, as they are components, the quantity can be modified by loot boosters such as Sia and Loot Bugles, though there’s no guarantee they will drop in the first place.


 Minor artifact components can be found at the Chronos Ruins, Haunted Castle and Sunken Temple quests.
 Greater artifact components can be found at the Elysium quest.


Artifact components can also be found in their respective chests.

New Furniture Levels
Furniture can now be upgraded to level 25! More energy and resource capacity for those with the Dragonmarks to spare! Always dry on Dragonmarks? We’ve got that covered further down below.

Tier 14 Enchantments
Six new Elements and six new Spirits are now available! You’ll need the new Supreme Runestone to craft them, though! But good news, it’s also available!

Since we’re on the topic of stones, Supreme Moonstones are available, too.

Merchant Level Loops
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/2f7d7a38e2c0f0cb85cc67f60825b2f6092b2020.jpg
There’s not too many players at level 99 yet, but with Advanced Research’s XP bonuses, that might change! Level 100 is now available, following usual rules. But it’s also possible to go beyond!

The next level after 100 is… 1! Breaking through level 100 will bring you back to level 1 and grant a new look to your level banner to let everyone know you’re not an average schmuck. Life’s a breeze down in the low digits though, and the XP requirements return back to their early-game values. Once you manage to make it back to 100 again, there’s another loop! In fact, the new level cap is 500!

Each time you loop, you’ll be met with a renewed XP curve, but with an added +25% XP requirement. Although there isn’t anything new to unlock, you’ll still receive those 5 gems per level. As an added bonus, each Loop will add either 10 bonus Ascension Shards or 5 extra gems to your level up rewards.

Shop Expansion Fine Tuning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/9fdd14bf5a962bc72ad0968b1a01112fd21020dd.jpg
Shop designers, are you tired of that standard 3x3 shop? Too little front yard space to fit all those firework cannons? This one's for you.

With this update, it is now possible to transform any shop segment into yard space! Furniture Space granted by the expansion will be retained, but the actual area will become outdoor grass, allowing the placement of outdoor decorations.

Creative use of this feature can allow for things like a donut-shaped shop, a teeny-tiny shop with a massive backyard, or even a weird disconnected shed in the back. The only limitation is that the entrance portion of the shop cannot be transformed. The rest is fair game!*

With this expanded customization potential, the need to save shop layouts and designs becomes more pronounced. The team is currently looking into this functionality, although no promise as to when.

*The Counter also needs to be accessible from the entrance, so you won’t be able to place it in the shed.

Seed of Merit
This valuable seed can be used on a Hero or Champion to increase their max level by one, to a maximum of +10 per character. You still need to earn that level with XP though!

With these seeds, it is possible to go beyond the current level cap of 40, or whichever limit is set by your current Training Hall level.

These seeds are currently exclusive to the Shop Titans 5th Year Anniversary Sale (June 14th), but a fusion recipe will be revealed in a future update.

5th Anniversary Login Calendar
Log in every day from June 12th to June 18th to claim Gems, Ascension Shards and Research Scrolls!

Major Changes
Ascension Milestones
New milestone rewards are now available for Stones, Spirits and Elements.

Dragon Invasion Rewards
“More furniture levels? But I’m nowhere close to level 20 in the first place!” Right you are, shopkeeper. In addition to this level cap increase, we are also massively increasing the amount of Dragonmarks awarded by the Dragon Invasion event. Doubled, in fact. You don’t even need to work harder for it, the quantities are simply doubled for this event (and future ones). What’s the catch? There’s none*.

*There really isn’t.

Advanced Research
Elements, Spirits, Runestones and Moonstones are now available for Advanced Research. As these item types cannot be surcharged, the Surcharge Energy Cost upgrade is not available. 

Minor Changes

 The Golden Artifact component has been renamed to Golden Chunk to distance it from Artifact blueprints. The Abyssal Artifact blueprint gets to stay.
 The Starter Pack now looks a lot cooler!


Balance Changes

 The odds to drop a Chest Exclusive (e.g. mostly blueprints) has been increased to 1% (from 0.5%) for Lost City of Gold chests.
 The gold cost to purchase Talent points has been reduced across the board.
 Supreme Moonstones and Runestones can now be found in various quests.
 The Elemental Barrier requirements of the Elysium quest have been increased.
 Tier 14 fusions now require Supreme Moonstones instead of Perfect Moonstones, though in lesser quantities.
 Elemental Blueprints from the Elysium chest are now enchanted with Tier 14 enchantments. This also increases their values slightly.
 Since Merchant Level 100 is now available, it also unlocks a Talent point. It’s the last one, though!
 Reduced the Ascension Milestone requirements for Meals, Desserts, Instruments, Aurasongs.
 Velites can now use Amulets.
 The cooldown when claiming promo codes has been removed.


Affinity Changes
The following Blueprints have received a new spirit affinity: Titan Sword, Zeus Thunderblade, Olympus, Titan Crossbow, Titan Potion, Titan Plate Armor, Titan Helm, Titan Boots, Titan Shield, Crag Guardian, Serial Quiller, Birdbane Halberd, Bleakspire Charm, Tianglong Lance, Draconic Eyestalk, Dragonfang Fists, Dragon Sacred Gem, Dragon Emperor’s Cloak, Jötunnbane, Neptune’s Authority, Caduceus.

The following Blueprints have had their spirit affinity replaced with a new one; Raptor Wings, Raptor Talons, Mark of Ouroboros, Leviathan (you’ll never guess which spirit).

Webstore Updates
New Research Scrolls Offer
By popular community request, we've added a new offer for 1000 Research Scrolls to help you with your Advanced Research needs or otherwise. This offer will be available a few days after the release of the 17.0 Update.

5th Anniversary Webstore Giveaway
Starting June 14th, we're running a daily giveaway to celebrate our 5th anniversary — exclusively on the webstore. Check back every day for five days for a free claimable item. You'll only have 24 hours to claim your free item each day so don't miss out!

King Schedule
King Reinhold will be available as a Guest Champion from June 25th until June 28th.

Bug Fixes

 The Talent Tree icon will now longer show on component drops modified by Common Farmer.
 Fixed an issue where the “View Rewards” button would become unresponsive after donating an item in the Collection Book.
 Fixed a rare issue where an inactive player could sometimes appear in the Tower of Titans event leaderboard rankings.
 Fixed an issue where multicrafted items incremented achievement progress by one instead of two.
 Fixed a rare case where the Brand Loyalty talent could trigger on items worth more Energy than the player’s total.
 Mundra’s Skull now properly requires Mundra as a worker.
 Fixed the Staff Master title unlocking earlier than intended.
 Fixed Advanced Research nodes being impossible to purchase if accessed through the city.
 Fixed Mercenaries receiving increased effect from boosters.
 Fixed a minor issue where an item’s affinity would be displayed under its quality in some menus.
 Fixed Aurasongs and Familiars that are too high tier for a Champion to equip; they are now properly displayed as such.
 Reduced the Defense stat of the Crispy Roast Duck, as it was inadvertently given two “high” stats.
 Fixed a bug where Advanced Research could not be unlocked if accessed through some menus.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Dreams of Elysium Update
notes.notes:
New Content
Tier 14 is Here!
A whopping 38 blueprints are now available, and they’re super valuable! Can these numbers even fit on the screen!? You might need a bigger phone!

If you haven’t fused all your Research Scrolls, look forward to the cursed sword Durandal, the Tincture of Finality potion or the Hell’s Gate shield! Need some help crafting this prestigious new tier? Read below!

Tier 14 can be equipped by level 38 Heroes, and can be traded on the market by players at level 66.

Advanced Research!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/c5007299fd1362a97eaa37c9e6904b18e9b3a158.png
These Tier 14 crafting times sure are impressive! Thankfully, the city’s Workers have found a solution; Advanced Research! Upon reaching level 36, each Worker will reveal a set of possible upgrades for their preferred item types.

The upgrades are the same across all item types (with few exceptions), and allow you to improve Craft Speed, Surcharge Energy Cost and Merchant XP of their blueprint types. The XP bonus applies to all item types and also stacks, so you can really supercharge your Merchant levels.

At first glance, it may look similar to the Talent Tree, but have no fear! Your precious Talent points are not needed here. Given enough time and investment, all Advanced Research can be unlocked. Each upgrade simply requires both Gold and Research Scrolls, although Gems can also be used.

New Quest!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/9a32f5f7965471eeebbe10b4ebb34df28e90c73c.png
Among the clouds lies Elysium, the domain of the gods! A place untouched by foolish mortals… until today! There’s bound to be valuables around! 

Upon these heavenly grounds roams the Avatar (no, not that one), imbued with a spark of divinity and a mandate to punish all interlopers. But where have all the gods gone?

Elysium is available for 10G gold for players at level 64 or above.

Major Changes
City Worker Visitors
Visitors from the city that come to sell items will now be limited to the highest blueprint tier you’ve crafted +3. That is, if the highest tier you’ve crafted is 5, worker visitors could bring bundles of items up to tier 8, provided you own some. It is no longer required for you to have crafted those items for them to be valid.

This is an iteration and compromise over a recent bugfix (which didn’t even work) intended to prevent worker visitors from selling items you’ve never crafted. We understand that receiving highly valuable items you normally wouldn’t have access to is exciting and rewarding, but would also like to prevent cases where newer players are asked to buy items worth several thousand times their net worth*.

*Astute observers may notice that the previous bugfix coincided with the Darkness Millennium blueprint, a Tier 13 blueprint that was given out to all players.

Minor Changes

 Due to Terms of Service conflicts with iOS, the Promo Code feature has been disabled on Apple devices. We are currently investigating supporting promo codes on our website for these players.
 The “Bonus rewards” from Dragon Invasion are no longer hidden before reaching the grand prize.
 Craft qualities with a chance of 20% or higher will no longer display a celebration screen upon claiming. Typically applies to Superior quality during Quality events or low tier items.


Balance Changes

 Polonia can now loot items up to Tier 11, up from 10. 
 Reduced the amount of crafts needed to upgrade and master mid-tier blueprints (tier 6 to 10).
 Slightly reduced the amount of Research Scrolls required to unlock mid-tier blueprints (Tier 7 to 10).
 The introduction of the massive XP bonuses from Advanced Research had us notice that some blueprint lines had disproportionately high XP values. They have been reduced down to be more in line with other types (Spears, Axes, Rings and Shields were most affected).
 The Carpenter is now the primary worker for Axes of Tier 4 and higher, to better match his ownership of Axes under Advanced Research.
 The Emerald Inn and the Tavern have received new levels to accommodate the new quest. Their investment requirements have also been reduced.
 Void Dimension and Cinderlake Volcano no longer feature Elemental Barriers on Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty. The bosses still have them, however.


King Schedule
King Reinhold will personally join your ranks as a Guest Champion on April 29th, leaving on May 2nd.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed the Extreme Boss of Barren Wastes dropping items of a lower tier than intended.
 Fixed an issue where some players received Spin Tickets in their inventory where they could not be used. The tickets have been removed and substituted with actual spins.
 Fixed an instance where a progress bar SFX could be stuck playing forever.
 Fixed a rare bug allowing invalid placement of Wall Decorations.
 Fixed a display issue involving the Treasure Hunter talent and Royal Merchant loot slot.
 Fixed market filters sorting when accessed from the pet feeding menu.
 Fixed a minor texture issue with the Iridescent Pet Rock skin.
 Fixed an issue with the Particle Beam Rifle blueprint in which two could be crafted at once after obtaining the second milestone upgrade.
 Fixed enchanted items not being counted for Fusion inventory count.
 Fixed the fusion warning for enchanted items not surfacing if the locked item warning surfaced previously.
 Fixed a crash that could occur when inspecting a Pet Skin through an offer.
 Fixed an issue where the text for Gold gained from selling over capacity components on the quest loot screen could be misaligned.
 Fixed a bug allowing some offers to be purchased multiple times.
 Fixed a rack bug causing the auto-restock function to behave unusually under some circumstances.
 Fixed Champions playing an instrument SFX upon buying an instrument bundle.
 Fixed an issue where power ratings were inconsistent when adding Rudo to a quest party.

notes.title: Full Bloom Update

Full Bloom Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/ea0bd42b016f1e91f4ce36509770c69a87a66b27.png
Spring is blooming and so is this new Content Pass! Complete tasks and collect Spring Blossoms to unlock blueprints, decorations and more! This pass will run from March 19th until April 3rd, so don’t miss it!

notes.title: Version 15.3.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
If you were quick to download the latest update, you may have noticed a mild inconvenience… such as your heroes getting completely stripped of their equipment whenever they’d be on quest! Beyond the almost guaranteed party wipe that would result and the hassle of re-equipping your entire roster, there was also the very real danger of accidentally selling off very valuable gear.

Due to the severity of the issue, we opted to disable questing as we worked to resolve the issue. If you’ve seen quests randomly disappear in the past 24 hours, this was the reason.

A new client update is now available to download which fixes the “equipment stripping” problem and re-enables quests. It’s now (finally) safe to quest! 

With this mess out of our way, we can now properly focus on compensation for the inconvenience incurred. We’ll have more info on this soon; thank you for your patience!

Update: Details of the compensation package can be found here.

Other Bug Fixes

 All boss cooldowns have been reset, as boss attempts would be automatically canceled but would still go on cooldown.

notes.title: Year of the Dragon Update
notes.notes:
New Content
Year of the Dragon Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/6d23376a989ca26a036a656167e3f561e6f11715.jpg
This year marks the Year of the Dragon, and the townsfolk are holding a month-long event; the Dance of Dragons! This period will feature a Content Pass themed around dragons beginning on January 23rd and running through February 19th. It features new exciting and exclusive rewards, such as blueprints, decorations, customizations and a very special new pet!

In addition, the very prestigious Great Dragon title will be awarded to all players who manage to finish the entire Year of the Dragon Content Pass!

Month of Full Moon
A special full moon rises over the Dance of Dragons event! We have extended our usual Full Moon fusion period to be active throughout the duration of the Content Pass, meaning a whole month!

For players who have not hired Mundra, this means the entire library of Full Moon Fusions will be available to you! For Mundra owners, you’ll benefit from 25% faster fusion speed instead! It’s the perfect time to fuse tribute for Mundra!

New Pet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/d490df0fb5803cba0bc9c548b396da2f72be7ad5.jpg
Perhaps our most requested pet yet has finally showed up! There’s no better time than the Year of the Dragon to introduce the Dragon pet! This little wyrm can be acquired through the Year of the Dragon Content Pass!

Lunar New Year Login Event
Login every day from Feb 9th to the 15th to claim gems and other prizes! In addition, a giveaway for an exclusive Dragon Statue will be running during that same period!

Lunar New Year Collection
A collection to celebrate the new year which includes decorations, customizations and more will be available on January 23rd and running through February 19th, same as the Content Pass.

Rack Management
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/19f92cb51cc9c8a5fa092391ebc33afabf740e59.jpg
We’ve introduced a new option for every rack allowing better fine-tuning over their content. For each rack, you can now disable some (or all) item types from being stocked there. If you’ve always dreamt of a Shelf exclusively stacked to the brim with scrumptious desserts right beside your counter, that dream is now a possibility!

Major Changes
Antique Store Expansion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/3355bdf73933f6b1775d6a2043c0e127decc9898.jpg
The Antique Store just got a little bit bigger! It now supports 6 different slots, rather than 4. Here are the rules for each slot:

Slot 1
Contains a random blueprint of tier 7 or higher. For newer players, Blueprints of Tier 7 will be preferred.

Slot 2
Contains a random blueprint of tier 6 or lower.

Slot 3
Contains a random Decoration or Decoration skin.

Slot 4
Contains a random Shopkeeper Customization, Pet or Pet Appearance.

Slot 5
Contains a random Flooring, Wallpaper or Shop Frame (though none exist for the latter).

Slot 6
Royal Merchant only. Can generate antiques from any of the other slots.

Though as always, remember that content must qualify as an antique before it can show up in the Antique store.

Elemental Barrier Redesign
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/e9be488147cb44dfd84a82e513f7e30bc0e03c7a.jpg
The Elemental Barrier mechanic has been simplified! On the quest preparation screen for quests featuring this mechanic, a new target value will be displayed. If the party’s total Element value of that element is high enough to match or surpass it, the monster’s Barrier will be disabled and full damage will be dealt during the entire battle.

Failing to match the target value, however, will result in the monster boasting its full Barrier for the entire battle, reducing damage taken by 80%.

This change allows us to better display and explain this mechanic while also toning down some RNG elements (such as your Dark Sorcerer getting abruptly deleted on the first round by an unlucky crit).

Since party members can no longer “chip away” at a monster’s Barrier, these target values have been rebalanced across the board. In general, regular Extreme quests will require one Hero of the correct element (assuming proper enchantments). Tougher quests (such as Void, or some Flash Quests) may require support from Element Affinities to reach the required thresholds.

Champion Requests
Champions now also provide full gold value for the items they are requesting, in addition to the Champion Coins. This is an experimental feature.

Obviously from a player perspective, more gold = more better, but given this mechanic’s tight relationship with the market, we’ll be monitoring its impact on the economy before deciding if it will remain or not.

King Schedule
King Reinhold will be available as a Guest Champion on February 5th until the 8th.

Balance Changes

 Following the Elemental Barrier changes, Rudo’s leader skill now increases the Elemental Score of his party with no round limit.


Misc. Changes
Various optimizations were performed, particularly involving low-end devices. This is an attempt at solving the increasing amount of crash reports we’ve been receiving lately. More optimizations are expected in the near future.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed Champion “rank up stats” disappearing after promoting your Champion with a Champion Titan Soul. This is a visual issue only.
 Fixed skills on the skill reroll screen not displaying as their proper rank (e.g. Extra Conditioning instead of Herculean Effort).
 Fixed an incredibly rare instance where an inactive guildmaster would not be replaced.
 Fixed some issues concerning the post-event gem rush option for rewards. Also better clarified.
 Fixed a rare instance where a bounty could initially appear as blank on the Bounty Board after a Bounty Board reset.
 Fixed an issue where customers would not be Familiar or Aurasong friendly at the intended rate.
 Fixed an issue where switching equipment would remove the applied vanity gear preference on heroes.
 Fixed an issue where the alternative reward for a Content Pass premium reward tier would display instead of the correct reward.
 Fixed an issue where Pet Skins did not properly display in the Content Pass “Next Reward” tracker.
 Returned the stat values of rings and shields back to their original values. This is an extension of previous fixes related to their gold value.

notes.title: Dragon Revision Update
notes.notes:

Christmas Content Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/491132fa26b952d7c3ff647b8d13a98c25d1af6d.jpg
Ho ho ho! Are you kids ready to collect Candy Canes? This Content Pass is similar to the Bjorn Content Pass, featuring antique content alongside a shorter duration. It begins on December 22nd and runs through January 8th.

To celebrate the holidays, starting on December 26th 10AM ET and running until December 28th 10AM ET, enjoy +25% Better Deals, +25% Multicraft and -25% Haggle all at the same time!

notes.title: The Magic of Music Update
notes.notes:
New Content
New Premium Worker
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/632ef200cdf89dd8fe06a70d602bd614b3beffb6.jpg
Yohan the Bard has joined the city! He’s a bit shy, but he’ll do his best! He is available for hire for players of level 18 or higher.

Yohan brings with him two new blueprint lines; magical Instruments and the mighty Aurasongs. On top of that, his Worker Power allows the upgrade of two furniture at the same time!

Instruments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/1a611ff18f65a93eb090b8461f2736137514ff78.jpg
Chimes and Drums have hit the shops! This new premium blueprint line features a wide variety of instruments such as trumpets, guitars and even the mighty triangle. Because of this, the resource types required for them can vary wildly from one item to another.

Instruments also have a special shop effect! Whenever purchased by a customer, that person will play a few notes before departing. Nearby characters (except Rudo) will love it and grant you a tiny bit of free energy!

Instruments are a type of magical weapon and can be equipped by most Spellcasters. A few other classes, such as Dancers (due to their connection with music) and Berserkers (because it’s funny) can also equip them.

Aurasongs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/097058b524e054b08740f58e6731dd76141d4891.jpg
Aurasongs are special gemstones enchanted with music. Similar to Familiars, they can only be equipped by Champions (in a dedicated equipment slot) and provide them with a unique Aura. The Aurasong grants stat bonuses to Champions, but the Aura also grants a bonus to the whole party. Each Aura has their own effect!

Like Familiars, although no Hero class can equip them, some daring customers will occasionally ask to buy them.

Champion Titan Soul
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37355981/48184df26a8847e93fae29824c959b3c93d4c1f6.jpg
Officially revealed as part of the Black Friday offer, the Champion Titan Soul is now available as a fusion recipe. It’s a tough one, though!

The Champion Titan Soul itself is a special variant of the Titan Soul. It can be used on any Champion to grant them a major stat boost! Upon upgrade, the Champion receives bonus stats equal to two rank-ups. In addition, all stats received from rank-ups (past and future) receive a 50% boost!

Creating a Champion Titan Soul requires a very difficult fusion! It lands squarely in the “endgame grind” for advanced players. The recipe is the following:

 2x Titan Souls
 1x Legendary Item (T10+)
 5x Mythic XP Drinks
 10x Phoenix Feathers
 300x Perfect Moonstones

You'll also need a level 37 Sun Dragon before attempting the fusion. Good luck!*

No actual luck is involved, the fusion does not have a chance to fail.

Minor Changes

 The city has expanded! Things were getting a bit tight in there, so the layout has been updated to make more space for the Bard and future newcomers. There’s a beach now!
 When buying an item in the Antique Store or Fortune Store, its slot will instantly be restocked instead of going on a cooldown.
